title: Guilty Gear X - Advance Edition
sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 6209 (addresses via C2 ra_notes.py)
notes: Genre: Fighting. Live values from RA notes, not checked in a running game unless said. PC mGBA sweep (boot, mash, walk; C2 gbaverify): P1 440 (full) -> 335, P2 440 -> 0 in an arcade fight, score rising 8800..57200. C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text: Life bar, Tension gauge (fills by attacking) and the round timer.
widgets.label: Meters

widgets.text:
Four attacks: Punch, Kick, Slash, Heavy Slash (button map in Options)
Dust: a launcher; Roman Cancel costs 50% Tension
widgets.label: Controls

widgets.text:
Faultless Defence (hold block + two buttons) costs Tension.
Instant Kill: dangerous one-hit move, available when its mode is on.
widgets.label: Systems

widgets.text:
Don't stand still: the game punishes passivity with the Negative Penalty.
Burst out of combos when the Burst gauge is full.
widgets.label: Tips

widgets.text:
Overdrives (supers) cost 50% Tension.
Roman Cancel 50%. Faultless Defence drains while held.
widgets.label: Using Tension

widgets.text: Sol, Ky, May, Millia, Axl, Potemkin, Chipp, Eddie, Baiken, Faust, Testament, Jam, Anji, Johnny, Venom, Dizzy, Zappa...
widgets.label: Characters

widgets.text: Clear Arcade with each character to see their ending.
